intro: Shanghai is the busiest place in China to listen. Two international airports feed the same terminal airspace, the Yangtze estuary and Yangshan carry more container traffic than anywhere on earth, and the licence-free 409 MHz band is saturated with construction crews, delivery riders and restaurant staff at all hours. Municipal services are digital and out of reach, but the airband and the marine band more than make up for it.
introz: 上海是中国最热闹的收听地点。两座国际机场共用同一片终端空域，长江口和洋山港的集装箱吞吐量全球第一，而免执照的 409 MHz 频段全天候被工地、外卖骑手和餐厅员工占满。市政部门已数字化，收不到，但航空和海事波段完全弥补了这一点。

stations.d: China's largest international gateway, with four runways and heavy widebody traffic through the evening. Set the VX-6 to AM and sweep the tower range from the observation areas or from Nanhui. Domestic traffic is worked in Mandarin, international in English.
stations.dz: 中国最大的国际门户，四条跑道，傍晚宽体机流量很大。把 VX-6 设为 AM，在观景区或南汇一带扫塔台频段。国内航班用中文，国际航班用英文。

stations.d: Pudong and Hongqiao are close enough that approach control has to interleave them, which makes for genuinely interesting listening.
stations.dz: 浦东和虹桥距离很近，进场管制必须交叉排序，因此通话内容相当有意思。

stations.d: Mostly domestic and business traffic, right in the middle of the city. Easier to receive from an apartment than Pudong.
stations.dz: 以国内航班和公务机为主，位置就在市区中间。在公寓里比浦东容易收到。

stations.d: Shanghai controls one of the densest enroute sectors in Asia. From a high floor in Pudong you will hear aircraft hundreds of kilometres out.
stations.dz: 上海管制着亚洲最密集的航路扇区之一。在浦东的高楼层能收到几百公里外的航班。

stations.z: 海事 16 频道 · 遇险与呼叫
stations.d: Constant traffic. The Yangtze estuary handles pilots, container ships, bulk carriers and river craft simultaneously, and the Maritime Safety Administration is always working. Excellent from the Bund, Binjiang or the Yangshan bridge.
stations.dz: 通话不断。长江口同时容纳引航员、集装箱船、散货船和内河船舶，海事局全天有业务。在外滩、滨江或东海大桥一带收听极佳。

stations.z: 上海船舶交通管理 12 频道
stations.d: Vessel Traffic Service sequencing the estuary. Channel assignments vary by sector — scan 156.300–156.800 to find the active one.
stations.dz: 船舶交通管理服务负责长江口排序。各分区频道不同——扫 156.300–156.800 找当前在用的。

stations.d: Pilots and tugs arranging passing in a very narrow, very crowded channel.
stations.dz: 引航员和拖轮在极窄、极拥挤的航道里协调会让。

stations.z: 海事 06 频道 · 船间通话

stations.n: 公众对讲机 — sweep all 20 channels
stations.z: 公众对讲机 · 20 个信道全扫
stations.d: In Shanghai this band is never quiet. Construction sites, mall security, hotel housekeeping, tour groups on the Bund, delivery dispatch. Scanning 409.7500–409.9875 is the fastest way to get a feel for a neighbourhood.
stations.dz: 在上海这个频段从不安静：工地、商场保安、酒店客房、外滩的旅游团、外卖调度。扫 409.7500–409.9875 是了解一个街区最快的方式。

stations.z: 警务、消防与地铁 · 数字制式
stations.d: Shanghai's public security runs encrypted PDT on 350 MHz, and the metro uses digital TETRA. Neither is decodable on an analog receiver.
stations.dz: 上海公安使用 350 MHz 加密 PDT，地铁使用数字 TETRA，模拟接收机都无法解码。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速线路
stations.d: Scan 450–460 MHz near ordinary main lines and freight yards. The Shanghai area still has plenty of conventional operation alongside the high-speed network.
stations.dz: 在普速干线和货场附近扫 450–460 MHz。上海地区在高铁网络之外仍有大量普速作业。

stations.d: One of the largest rail hubs in the world, and entirely on digital GSM-R. Nothing to hear.
stations.dz: 全球最大的铁路枢纽之一，但全部使用数字 GSM-R，听不到任何内容。

stations.d: A useful habit in China: stations often put the frequency in the brand name. 动感101 is 101.7, 经典947 is 94.7, and provincial traffic stations usually do the same. It makes the dial largely self-documenting.
stations.dz: 在中国有个好用的规律：电台常把频率放进台名里。动感101 就是 101.7，经典947 就是 94.7，各省交通广播通常也一样。整个频段基本上是自带说明的。

stations.d: Shanghai's classical station, and a genuinely good one.
stations.dz: 上海的古典音乐台，水准确实不错。

stations.n: 上海交通广播 — traffic radio
stations.d: The most practically useful station in the city. Elevated-road conditions, tunnel closures and weather, updated constantly.
stations.dz: 全市最实用的电台。高架路况、隧道封闭和天气持续更新。

stations.n: Medium wave 990 kHz — and the night band
stations.z: 中波 990 kHz 与夜间频段
stations.d: After dark the medium wave band from the Bund is remarkable — Japanese, Korean and Southeast Asian stations arrive over the sea alongside high-power domestic transmitters. Remember Chinese medium wave uses 9 kHz spacing.
stations.dz: 天黑后在外滩收中波非常精彩——日本、韩国和东南亚的电台越海而来，与国内大功率台混在一起。注意中国中波是 9 kHz 间隔。

stations.d: From Pucheng, Shaanxi. Also on 2.5, 10 and 15 MHz.
stations.dz: 陕西蒲城发播，另有 2.5、10、15 MHz。

stations.d: The Yangtze Delta has an active amateur community. Ask the local 无线电协会 for current repeater details rather than trusting any published list.
stations.dz: 长三角的业余无线电活动比较活跃。中继台的具体参数建议直接问当地无线电协会，不要依赖网上的列表。
